page.overview:
Who is Adam Arterius?

Adam Arterius was a wizard who attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry during the 21st century.

Adam was born at some point between 1990 and 1997, as he was attending Hogwarts during the same time as an unidentified Muggle-born Hogwarts student. Along with his friend, Marcus Morhaven, he wanted to explore the Great Lake, though the last time he had done so, one of the Merpeople that lived in the lake tickled his feet and scared him. Despite this interaction, he still wondered what the merfolk thought of the students at Hogwarts.

In December 2010, Adam talked to his friend Marcus about their recent visit to Hogsmeade. He thought it was fun but Marcus was overwhelmed with the sweets and Butterbeer and shops on offer. They also wondered if it was true that Hogsmeade was as old as Hogwarts.
